description: Military-grade cyber-amphetamine. The label is mostly warnings.

overdose.message: Your heart is a fist clenching until it cannot open again.

phases.comedown_message: The wire goes slack. Your hands start to shake.
phases.comeup_message: Your pulse redlines. The world drops into slow motion.
phases.end_message: The crash lands on you like a dropped ceiling.
phases.peak_message: You are made of wire and lightning. Nothing can touch you.

withdrawal.message: Your teeth won't stop grinding. You need another hit.

effects.onset_message: Your heart finds the new gear and stays there.

name: Redline
